# Story Breakdown (Units Generation) Reference

**Generated by**: `inception/units-generation.md`. This is AI-DLC's existing Units Generation stage, reframed as the "Story Breakdown" step in the Global Spec-First flow — it runs after EARS exists (Application Design, Step 10.2) and turns approved EARS requirements into PR-sized, independently deployable/testable units.

**No new file location** — this reference describes how `unit-of-work.md` (already produced by Units Generation) should incorporate EARS coverage; it does not introduce a separate artifact.

## Required additions to `unit-of-work.md`

For each unit:

```markdown
### EARS Coverage — [Unit Name]
- aidlc-docs/inception/requirements/ears/auth-login-ears.md (AUTH-LOGIN-001 to AUTH-LOGIN-030)
```

```markdown
| AC ID | Unit | Scenario | Acceptance Criteria | EARS ID(s) | Verification Method | Priority |
|------|------|----------|---------------------|------------|---------------------|----------|
| AC-001 | [Unit Name] | [Scenario Name] | [Measurable expected behavior] | [AUTH-LOGIN-001] | [Test/Review/Automation] | [Must/Should/Could] |
```

`AC-###` identifies the *test scenario*; the EARS ID identifies the *requirement* — complementary, not competing schemes.

## Coverage Rule (Mandatory)

Every non-deferred (`[ ]`) EARS ID relevant to a unit's scope must be assigned to **exactly one** unit (shared/cross-cutting requirements may span more than one unit only with explicit justification recorded in `unit-of-work.md`). A unit is not "ready for design stages" until this holds.

## PR Size Guardrails

Unchanged from AI-DLC's existing Units Generation rules — see `inception/units-generation.md` "PR Size Guardrails (Mandatory)". EARS Coverage doesn't relax these: split a unit further if adding EARS coverage pushes it over budget.

## Personas & User-Story Framing (No Separate Stage)

There is no standalone "User Stories" stage. A unit's Gherkin `Feature`/`Scenario` **is** its user story — grounded in the unit's EARS Coverage rather than early, EARS-less prose (see `inception/units-generation.md` Step 2.1 and `design-driven-dev-guide.md` for why this ordering matters). `personas.md` (`aidlc-docs/inception/application-design/personas.md`) is generated conditionally, only when personas genuinely add value (multiple distinct user types, customer-facing feature, cross-team alignment need) — not as a default artifact.
